utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Uli, just checking in on the club dues — did you want to pay them now or later?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Later, please — I need a bit of time before I can sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — just let me know when you’re ready, and I’ll sort it out with you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d want to make sure we have the exact dues amount and due date before anyone pays. Maybe we should write it down so there’s no mix-up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, can you confirm the exact amount and the due date for me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the exact numbers yet, so I’d rather not guess. Let’s check the notice or ask the treasurer and then write it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—club dues. I probably missed the update; what’s the amount again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sorry Noah—I don’t have the exact number in front of me. I can check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — that’d help a lot. I’ll wait for the amount.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can pass that along — I’ll mention the dues and remind everyone about the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. I appreciate you reminding everyone about the dues and the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll bring up the dues and the plan at the next chance I get.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late — are we still talking about the club dues? If so, what's the amount this month?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, we’re still on it — this month’s dues are $20.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring $20 by later today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I can bring the dues by tomorrow afternoon. If you want, I’ll also make a quick note of the amount so we’re both clear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, tomorrow afternoon works for me — and yes, a quick note on the amount would be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll bring the dues tomorrow afternoon and write down the amount so we’re both on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, have the club dues been paid for this month?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, but I can take care of them today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam — can you let me know once it’s done?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I can help sort out the membership dues—what part do you want to go over?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I just want to confirm where the dues should be paid and who’s collecting them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — the dues go to the club treasurer, and they’re collecting them at the front desk this week. If you want, I can walk you over or point you to the exact person.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the dues—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you send in this month’s dues by Friday if you’re able? If that’s tricky, just let me know and we’ll work something out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can send them in by Friday. Thanks for checking in, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check the dues list and see who’s paid already.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. Just let me know who still owes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll go through it now and tell you the names of anyone still outstanding.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the dues are due this week, so I’m checking whether the club wants cash or if there’s an online option now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think they’re taking both, but I’d double-check with Mara at the desk just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call — I’ll ask Mara at the desk so I don’t show up with the wrong payment.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got this right—what are the dues amount and when are they due?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: They’re $25, and we’re asking for them by Friday if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that works for me—I'll bring the $25 by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can take care of the dues. Just send me the amount and how you'd like it paid.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — it’s $20 this month, and cash is fine if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, cash works — I’ll drop off the $20 soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll remind everyone the dues are due this week and I’ll bring it up again at the club meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’ll really help keep everyone on track. I appreciate you bringing it up at the meeting too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll remind everyone again before the meeting and make sure it comes up there, too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the club dues. Have they changed, or am I forgetting something again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, they haven’t changed. I just haven’t been able to sort mine out yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, got it — no change then. Don’t worry, you can sort yours out whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think the dues are due soon, right? I can pitch in once I know the amount.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, they’re due soon — I’ll check the exact amount and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate you checking — I’ll wait for the amount.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Opal, I’m just checking in on the club membership dues—whenever you’re ready, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’m ready to sort it out now. Where should I send the dues?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — you can send them to me here, and I’ll make sure they get recorded right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure we handle the dues the right way—when are they due, and how do we pay?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: The dues are due at the start of the month, and you can pay me in cash or send it over electronically if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I’ll probably send it electronically so it’s handled cleanly—does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the club membership dues are due this month, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—let me double-check the exact due date before we go with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—just let me know the exact date when you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d rather keep this simple—let’s set a clear amount and a due date for the club dues.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that works for me—just tell me the amount and when it’s due, and I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—let’s make it $20, due by the first of the month. That keeps it easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the dues are due soon, but I’m not totally sure on the details yet. Do you know how much they’re asking for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m not sure on the exact amount yet either, but I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the dues. I meant to bring that up; how much did you say it was again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s $20 for the month. If that’s tricky, I can remind you again later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — $20 for the month, got it. I’ll try to bring it by soon, and if I forget, please do remind me later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check our school schedule and see when I can swing by with the dues.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—just let me know what time works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll take a look after school and text you a time that works.
